title_en: Call for Applicants: Winter 2027 IBS Trapped-Ion Quantum Science Research Internship
summary: Undergraduate students in their third or fourth year, and students deferring graduation, in physics, optics, electronic engineering or a related field may apply for the Winter 2027 research internship at the Institute for Basic Science (IBS) Center for Trapped-Ion Quantum Science. Applicants must submit their academic transcript and résumé together by email to both addresses given in the original notice between 5 November and 30 November 2026. The internship runs from 1 January to 26 February 2027 at IBS headquarters, Building I, in Daejeon.
applies_to: Optional (voluntary application). Open to currently enrolled third- and fourth-year undergraduate students, and students deferring graduation, in physics, optics, electronic engineering or related fields. Students on leave of absence and graduates are not eligible.

dates.what: Internship activity period (start date and participation schedule may be arranged individually)

conditions: Applicants must be third- or fourth-year undergraduates or students deferring graduation, in physics, optics, electronic engineering or a related field.
Students on leave of absence are not eligible.
The transcript and résumé must be submitted together, to both email addresses given in the original notice.
The start date and participation schedule may be arranged individually with the research center.
steps: Confirm that you are a currently enrolled third- or fourth-year undergraduate, or a student deferring graduation, in physics, optics, electronic engineering or a related field, and that you are not on leave of absence or a graduate.
Prepare your academic transcript and your résumé.
Between 5 November and 30 November 2026, send the transcript and résumé together in one submission to both email addresses listed in the original notice.
For questions, contact the program contact at the Center for Trapped-Ion Quantum Science; the contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
Call for Applicants: 2027 Winter Research Internship at the Institute for Basic Science (IBS) Center for Trapped-Ion Quantum Science

A. Program: 2027 Winter IBS Center for Trapped-Ion Quantum Science Research Internship

B. Eligibility: Currently enrolled third- and fourth-year undergraduate students, and students deferring graduation (졸업유예자), in physics, optics, electronic engineering and related fields (students on leave of absence and graduates are excluded).

C. Application period: Thursday 5 November 2026 to Monday 30 November 2026.

D. Activity period: Friday 1 January 2027 to Friday 26 February 2027. ※ The start date and participation schedule may be arranged individually.

E. Location: Institute for Basic Science (IBS) headquarters, Building I (55 Expo-ro, Yuseong-gu, Daejeon).

F. Main research activities:
1) Learning the principles of optical resonators (optical cavities), and building and aligning them
2) Measuring resonance signals and analysing the data
3) Monitoring and stabilising laser frequency

G. How to apply: Submit your academic transcript and résumé together to both of the two email addresses given in the original notice.

H. Enquiries: The program contact at the Center for Trapped-Ion Quantum Science (the phone number and email address are given in the original notice).
